description: A terminal task & note manager storing everything as plain files — todo.txt tasks and markdown notes — the durable memory layer for AI coding sessions across Claude Code, OpenCode, and Pi.
rules: nt is a CLI: tasks live in todo.txt-format tasks.txt, notes are markdown files with YAML frontmatter under notes/.
For AI agents, prefer the MCP server (`nt mcp`) — it exposes typed tools (nt_add, nt_note, nt_recall, nt_index, ...) instead of shell-quoting CLI calls.
Run `nt recall "<what you're about to do>"` before starting a task to surface past lessons before repeating a mistake.
Capture findings with `nt note "<title>" --kind lesson|decision|ref|rule|memory --description "..."` — kind picks the canonical tag and folder.
`nt index` is the session-start catalog (tiered on large stores); `nt show <id>`/`nt_get` fetches one note's full body on demand.
